statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-13505 (GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8): Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (bc-fips) before 2.1.3 zeroises key material held by the AES and DESede engines, the DRBGs, SymmetricSecretKey and the PBKD and scrypt parameter classes from Object.finalize, so disposal can fall behind under load and the key material stays in the heap meanwhile. 2.1.3 moves disposal to java.lang.ref.Cleaner (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%9013505). Upstream lists the affected platform as Java 9 and later and notes that in practice it did not bite on Java 11; this owner is a Java 11 runtime, but the finalizer-based code is present in the 2.1.2 builds and 2.1.3 is the upstream fix, so this is recorded as FIXED at the first build with 2.1.3 rather than as not affected. Covered every package of this owner published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repositories: eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips on x86_64 (16 versions, 11.0.30.7-r0 to 11.0.33.10-r1) and aarch64 (8 versions, 11.0.30.7-r0 to 11.0.31.11-r6, the same Bouncy Castle files as the x86_64 packages of those versions), eclipse-temurin-11-jre on x86_64 (the same 16 versions; none is published for aarch64), and the oci-config packages. Read the bundle version from the manifest of every Bouncy Castle jar in every published package of this owner, recursing into nested archives. Bouncy Castle is in the eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips package, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar next to the bcpkix-fips, bctls-fips, bcutil-fips and bc-rng-jent jars. The eclipse-temurin-11-jre packages hold no Bouncy Castle classes, in jrt-fs.jar or in the runtime image lib/modules, and the eclipse-temurin-11-jre-oci-config packages hold no jars. bc-fips is 2.1.2 in 11.0.30.7-r0 to 11.0.32.1.1-r0 and in 11.0.32.9-r0, and 2.1.3 in 11.0.32.1.1-r1 and in 11.0.32.9.1.1-r2 and every later build. Under apk version ordering 11.0.32.9-r0 sorts between those two fixed builds, so the range has two spans: affected below 11.0.32.1.1-r1, fixed from 11.0.32.1.1-r1, affected again from 11.0.32.9-r0, and fixed from 11.0.32.9.1.1-r2.

CVE-2026-13505 (GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8): in Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS, key material held by the AES and DESede engines, the SP 800-90A DRBGs, SymmetricSecretKey and the PBKD and scrypt parameter classes was zeroised on garbage collection through Object.finalize; the single finalizer thread can fall behind, so key material stays in the heap and the backlog can contribute to an OutOfMemoryError. The advisory says this was not a problem on Java 8 or Java 11 and becomes one on later JVMs, which includes the Java runtime these packages ship. bc-fips 2.1.x before 2.1.3 is affected, and 2.1.3 fixes it by running that disposal from a java.lang.ref.Cleaner on Java 9 and later: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%9013505. The DHI eclipse-temurin-17-jdk packages for Alpine 3.23 ship Bouncy Castle FIPS in their eclipse-temurin-17-jdk-fips subpackage, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar. Read the manifest of every jar in every published eclipse-temurin-17-jdk-fips package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine security repository (18 versions, 17.0.18.8-r0 to 17.0.21.9.1.2-r0; x86_64, and aarch64 for 17.0.18.8-r0 to 17.0.19.10-r6). The bc-fips jar is 2.1.2 in 17.0.18.8-r0 to 17.0.20.1.1-r0 and in 17.0.20.8-r0 and 17.0.20.8-r1, and 2.1.3 in 17.0.20.1.1-r1, and in 17.0.20.8.1.1-r2 and every later build. 17.0.20.8-r0 sorts after 17.0.20.1.1-r1 but went back to bc-fips 2.1.2, so the range closes at 17.0.20.1.1-r1, reopens at 17.0.20.8-r0 and closes again at 17.0.20.8.1.1-r2, the next build with 2.1.3. None of the eclipse-temurin-17-jdk, eclipse-temurin-17-jdk-oci-config or eclipse-temurin-17-jdk-fips-oci-config packages published for Alpine 3.23 contains a Bouncy Castle jar.

Upstream lists the affected platform as Java 9 and later and notes that in practice it did not bite on Java 11; this owner is a Java 11 runtime, but the finalizer-based code is present in the 2.1.2 builds and 2.1.3 is the upstream fix, so this is recorded as FIXED at the first build with 2.1.3 rather than as not affected. Covered every package built from this source in the DHI Debian 13 repositories: eclipse-temurin-11-jre for amd64 and arm64 and eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips (architecture all), each in 12 versions (11.0.31.11-0, 11.0.31.11-1, 11.0.32.1.1-0, 11.0.32.1.1-1, 11.0.32.9-0, and 1:11.0.32.1+1-2 to 1:11.0.33+10-0), and the oci-config packages; each download matched the index SHA256, except eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips-oci-config 1:11.0.32.1+1-4, whose served file differs from the index entry; its served contents are one configuration file and a changelog, with no jars. Read the bundle version from the manifest of every Bouncy Castle jar in every published package of this owner, recursing into nested archives. Bouncy Castle is in the eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips package, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar next to the bcpkix-fips, bctls-fips, bcutil-fips and bc-rng-jent jars. The eclipse-temurin-11-jre packages hold no Bouncy Castle classes, in jrt-fs.jar or in the runtime image lib/modules, and the eclipse-temurin-11-jre-oci-config packages hold no jars. bc-fips is 2.1.2 in 11.0.31.11-0, 11.0.31.11-1, 11.0.32.1.1-0 and 11.0.32.9-0, and 2.1.3 in 11.0.32.1.1-1 and in every epoch-1 build from 1:11.0.32.1+1-2 on. Under dpkg ordering 11.0.32.9-0 sorts between 11.0.32.1.1-1 and the epoch-1 builds, so the range has two spans: affected below 11.0.32.1.1-1, fixed from 11.0.32.1.1-1, affected again from 11.0.32.9-0, and fixed from 1:11.0.32.1+1-2.
